message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine appropriate crime(s) based on facts. The case involves theft of oil (原油) from pipeline, using stolen vehicle, storing in underground tank, etc. Also arson (fire) that destroyed vehicle, transformer, electric equipment. The crimes: theft (盗窃) of oil (public and private property). Also possibly “非法占有为目的，秘密窃取公私财物，数额较大” = theft. Also arson causing property damage: could be “放火” (arson) or “纵火”. In Chinese criminal law, arson is “放火罪”. The fire was accidental due to their own actions while stealing oil; they caused fire that destroyed property. That could be considered “放火罪” (arson) or “纵火罪”. The examples: earlier case of setting fire to house was labeled “放火”. So we should include “放火”. Also maybe “非法占有” is theft. So answer: 盗窃;放火.

Check if any other crimes: maybe “非法持有、使用假币” not relevant. “非法占有” is theft. Also “非法占有为目的，秘密窃取公私财物” is theft. So final answer: [罪名]盗窃;放火<eoa>
